informationArchitecture: Top nav must feel like a real SaaS product: Product, Use cases, Proof, Pricing/Pilot, Login.
Hero must pair a top-performing-proxy proof claim with a visible product artifact.
Follow hero with leader-inspired proof modules: visibility, competitor moves, source status, recommended action.
typography: Huge direct headline inspired by Peec and Semrush category language.
Muted second-line type can show scope without adding a weak subtitle.
Product artifact labels must be smaller but high-contrast, like Profound and Sprout.
color: Base should be white, black, and restrained graphite.
Use one signal accent for live/source/status, not a decorative brand gradient.
Dark variant allowed only as a premium alternate, not default unless readability wins.
productArtifact: Use an actual 0509-style market watch artifact: source, competitor, change, impact, confidence, next action.
Never paste Mobbin screenshots into the final UI.
Use reference structure, not reference brands or claims.
proof: Any public scale proof belongs to the benchmark ledger, not the 0509 sales copy unless it is about 0509.
The 0509 page can say pilot, source-backed, and proof-first only if current product truth supports it.
No enterprise customer logos, compliance badges, ROI numbers, or live monitoring claims unless verified for 0509.
motion: If used, motion should show signal freshness or source state changes.
Do not use motion to hide missing product truth.
cta: Primary CTA: Join pilot or Request pilot access.
Secondary CTA: See sample brief or Search public index.
No self-serve checkout unless the product and billing path are live.

designDecision: The redo should stop treating 0509 as a Mobbin Proving Lab-flavored proof desk and instead make it feel like a serious search/social/AI market-intelligence SaaS: Peec/Profound for AI visibility, Sprout for competitor performance and enterprise SaaS maturity, Clearbit/Mixpanel/Fey only as clearly labeled visual proxies for missing exact leaders.
